title: Oven-Roasted German Quinoa Wrap
description: A crisp, anti-inflammatory quinoa filling roasted to perfection and wrapped in soft corn husks for a German-inspired twist.
instructions: Rinse quinoa until water runs clear.
In a saucepan combine quinoa, water, allspice berries, turmeric, and a pinch of sea salt; bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Remove quinoa from heat and fluff with a fork; stir in dashi extract, sliced almonds, grated carrot, and chopped kale.
Spread the quinoa mixture evenly onto a parchment-lined baking sheet and roast 10 minutes until golden.
Soak corn husk wraps in warm water for 30 minutes.
Remove quinoa from oven and let cool 5 minutes.
Place roasted quinoa onto each softened corn husk, fold sides, roll tightly.
Place wrapped rolls seam-side down on a second baking sheet and bake 5 minutes to seal edges.
